text:
deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout: service=redwood-runtime model=rw-v1.2.3 -> shifting 10% traffic to canary in us-west1. release_notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/1.2.3 :eyes:
jen: quick Q — is this inside the 23:00-02:00 change window?
mike: yes, change window confirmed. ops said okay for low-impact canary.
irene: flag — eval suite showed a small tokenization mismatch on a subset of chinese prompts yesterday; scoped to older tokenizer shim. tracked in GH: https://github.com/redwood/release/issues/412
sam: can we pin the dedicated nodes that still run v1.2.2? want to avoid cross-version cache issues.
mike: good call. pinning target nodepool 'dedicated-a' for this canary. doing that now.
olivia: putting a quick smoke checklist here: 1) latency P50/P95 2) 5xx rate 3) kv-cache evictions 4) embed similarity QA.
jen: if any of those breach thresholds we stop and rollback. what are the exact thresholds?
mike: thresholds: P95 +150ms over baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% OR kv-evict rate > 10/min. also if embed drift > 2.5% fail rate.
jen: noted. deploy-bot — start 10% shift and ping when warmed?
deploy-bot: shift initiated at 1769990001. canary pods: rw-canary-7, rw-canary-8. healthchecks=passing. streaming logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/canary/1769990001
irene: watching embed evals. if drift >1.5% call stop.
sam: rollback command for quick use: ```kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/redwood-runtime --to-revision=stable-1.2.2```
mike: also have hotfix branch ready: release/hotfix-tokenizer-412 if tokenizer issue shows up.
jen: how long until we see stable telemetry? give it 12-15 minutes?
mike: should be ~10m for p95 to stabilize, 15m for embed sample evals to have signal.
olivia: starting canary monitor check now. watchlist posted to the dashboard.
deploy-bot: canary traffic = 10% (target 100rps -> canary ~10rps). next status update in 5m.
jen: if we need to pause, who has authority to pin/abort? I vote ops + release lead.
mike: agreed. ops (olivia) + release lead (jen) to decide.
olivia: ack. I'll put an ops hold if metrics degrade.
sam: quick sanity log snippet to run if we see KV errors: ```for pod in $(kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o name); do kubectl logs $pod | grep -i "kvcache evict" | tail -n 20; done```
jen: :thumbsup: OK let it run. monitoring window start.
deploy-bot: status @1769990030: healthchecks=passing, p95 delta=+12ms, 5xx=0.02%, kv-evict=0/min, embed-drift=0.3%
mike: that's clean. keep rolling.
irene: embed diffs look fine so far. continuing to watch the chinese tokenizer subset.
jen: keep the rollback command pinned in thread. if we get red flags call stop.
deploy-bot: status @1769990055: healthchecks=passing, p95 delta=+18ms, 5xx=0.04%, kv-evict=0/min, embed-drift=0.6% — no abort triggers met.
olivia: good to continue, will escalate immediately if any threshold crosses.
jen: moving to 25% in 10m if stable. any objections?
mike: no objections from infra.
sam: I'll prep the canary metrics dashboard URL and quick rollback playbook in case.
irene: thanks — standing by for tokenizer signal.
deploy-bot: noted. will post next update at 1769990100 or on status change.
